claude.performance_metric: delisted (Form 25-NSE 2018-09-12) and Exchange Act registration terminated (Form 15-12B 2018-10-04); no periodic report in 3-5yr window
claude.rationale: The slice documents only that the entity was delisted from the NYSE and terminated its Exchange Act registration within ~six months of closing, and filed no Form 10-K/20-F during the 2021-2023 window. No separate primary-filing record isolating the acquired business's realized trajectory was located, so the post-deal record is not publicly observable. Because the slice contains no evidence of realized disruption at the product/process interface or the process/organization interface, both pathways are coded uncertain rather than 0 or 1 — the absence here is an absence of observability, not a documented absence of disruption.
